```yaml
name: Bump Personal Server After Release

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

jobs:
  bump_personal_server:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install setuptools wheel

      - name: Run validation checks
        run: |
          make lint
          make test
          make workflow-security-checks

      - name: Update personal server version
        run: |
          sed -i "s/^Version:.*/Version: ${{ github.ref_name }}/" hushline-personal-server/DEBIAN/control
          sed -i "s/^version:.*/version: ${{ github.ref_name }}/" hushline-personal-server/var/lib/hushline/docker-compose.yaml

      - name: Commit changes
        run: |
          git config --global user.name "GitHub Actions"
          git config --global user.email "actions@github.com"
          git add hushline-personal-server/DEBIAN/control hushline-personal-server/var/lib/hushline/docker-compose.yaml
          git commit -m "Bump personal server version to ${{ github.ref_name }}"

      - name: Push changes
        uses: ad-m/github-push-action@v0.6.0
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.PERSONAL_SERVER_VERSION_BUMP }}
          branch: main

      - name: Create pull request
        id: create_pr
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.PERSONAL_SERVER_VERSION_BUMP }}
          title: "chore(personal-server): bump version to ${{ github.ref_name }}"
          body: |
            This PR bumps the personal server version to match the latest Hush Line release.
          base: main
          head: bump-personal-server-${{ github.ref_name }}

      - name: Merge pull request
        if: steps.create_pr.outputs.pull_request_merged == 'true'
        uses: peter-evans/auto-merge@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.PERSONAL_SERVER_VERSION_BUMP }}
          pull_number: ${{ steps.create_pr.outputs.pull_request_number }}
          merge_method: merge
```

This GitHub Actions workflow is triggered when a release is published. It updates the version numbers in the `hushline-personal-server/DEBIAN/control` and `hushline-personal-server/var/lib/hushline/docker-compose.yaml` files, commits these changes, pushes them to the main branch, creates a pull request to merge the changes, and automatically merges the pull request if it is approved. The workflow uses the `PERSONAL_SERVER_VERSION_BUMP` secret for authentication and authorization.
